body_markdown:
### [Flow-level timeout](https://www.windmill.dev/changelog/flow-timeout)


Flow editor


[v1.861.0](https://github.com/windmill-labs/windmill/releases/tag/v1.861.0)


[Docs](https://www.windmill.dev/docs/flows/custom_timeout#flow-timeout)


A flow can carry a timeout, in seconds, for its whole run, counted from when it starts running and including time spent sleeping or waiting at an approval. Set it under Runtime > Execution policy > Timeout in the flow settings.


#### New features


- When the timeout is reached, the running steps are cancelled, the error handler runs if the flow has one, and the run ends as cancelled by timeout.
- A pending approval is abandoned, even with continue on disapproval/timeout set.
- The timeout also applies when the flow runs as a subflow step, unless the calling step sets its own.
- A subflow that times out appears to its caller as a failed step, handled like any step failure.
